_readme: Append one entry per race, oldest first. Then run:  python3 tools/apply-race.py
It folds every entry newer than each page's watermark into the pages, and is
safe to re-run: entries already applied are skipped.
date        ISO race date. Also the ordering key and the watermark value.
name        Grand Prix name, for the log and commit message only.
circuit     Short venue name, used in the generated standfirst prose.
winner      Full driver name, exactly as it appears in the page tables.
team        Winning team key ('mclaren', 'ferrari'), or null if neither won.
starters    Per tracked team, the drivers who started. Each gets +1 GP.
prose       Optional. 'manual' leaves the standfirst wording alone, for a
win worth writing up by hand (a milestone, a first win).
A driver must already exist on the roster page before their first entry here:
a race result carries no tenure or debut year, so apply-race.py will stop and
say so rather than invent a row.
